records.text: Justin Streiff was overheard on the phone yelling that all of the money was missing from Turning Point Action.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 7FS1tUeSfdE)

appearances.snippet: someone from within the company, within the organization, confirmed to me. They said Justin (Justin Streiff) was actually overheard on the phone yelling about missing money, that all of the money was missing from Turning Point Action.

verification.notes: The transcript attributes this overheard call to an anonymous internal source and carefully labels it alleged. Searches found only repetitions traceable to Owens episode, not an identified witness, recording, financial record, audit, or independent report that could verify what Streiff said or whether money was missing.

links.title: Insider Says Streiff Yelled Money Was Missing
